name: Minimal Job Manager
author: Hitesh Chandwani

sections.description:
Minimal Job Manager is a minimal, lightweight and easy-to-use plugin for managing job listings and job applications on your WordPress website. It allows you to create custom job listings and let users apply for those jobs through a simple application form.

This plugin provides the following features:
– Jobs: Post job listings with titles, descriptions, and location details.
– Candidates can apply directly via a form.
– All job listings can be displayed using a shortcode on any page.
– Custom fields for job location.
– PDF and DOC file upload for resumes.

It’s designed to integrate well with popular page builders like Divi, and can be easily used on any WordPress site.

Key Features:
– Add and manage job listings with ease.
– Candidates can apply directly via a form.
– All job listings can be displayed using a shortcode on any page.
– Custom fields for job location.
– PDF and DOC file upload for resumes.

Shortcodes

Minimal Job Manager provides a useful shortcode to display all job listings on any page.

[mjmp_jobs]

This shortcode displays all published job listings. You can use it on any page, post, or widget area.

Usage Example:

[mjmp_jobs]

The shortcode will display all jobs with their titles, location, and a link to apply for each job. It also includes a “Apply Now” button that scrolls users to the application form.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the minimal-job-manager plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings from the plugin settings page or via the post type UI.
  4. You can now start posting jobs from the WordPress Dashboard.
sections.faq:
How do I add a job?

After installing the plugin, you can add jobs via the “Jobs” menu in the WordPress admin dashboard. Simply fill in the job title, description, and location to publish a job listing.

How do I customize the job listings?

You can customize the job listings by editing the template file or using custom CSS.

Can I use the plugin with Divi?

Yes! Minimal Job Manager is compatible with Divi. The plugin follows WordPress best practices to ensure it works seamlessly with popular page builders.
